title: TreeMaker solved layout
description: A grid layout of a tree's leaves, with the scale and edge lengths it was solved (or closed) at. Opening one shows it as if just solved, and the next solve can start from it.

tree.description: The tree, as in a tree file (without format and version).

scale.description: m, grid units per unit of tree length. Optional: the layout's exact scale is used when it is missing or too large.

edgeLengths.description: Edge lengths by edge index (the order of tree.edges), when they differ from the tree's: for example after closing the polygons with strain.

leaves.description: One grid point per leaf; every leaf of the tree must appear exactly once.

solvedBy.description: Where the layout came from. Informational only.
